newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEINEKEN'S APB OBTAINS PERMIT FOR INDIA.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN'S APB OBTAINS PERMIT FOR INDIA.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken NV said on Monday its joint venture Asia Pacific Breweries APB had obtained a permit to do business in India.
"You need a permit to negotiate on doing business in India. Now that we have a permit, we'll be able to take action if there's a good opportunity," spokeswoman Margritha Meijer said.
But she said Heineken had no firm plans as yet.

She said the Indian beer market was "relatively small" and concentrated in urban areas. Distribution in the country was difficult, she added. The Heineken brand is currently sold on a very small scale in India, mainly in international hotels.
